recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則且互相吻合成網狀，骨髓腔被疏鬆的纖維血管性結締組織取代、造血細胞稀少，符合 Paget 骨病的骨重塑異常。
features: Markedly increased bone volume with thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae
Trabecular surfaces with irregular scalloped outlines
Marrow spaces replaced by loose fibrovascular connective tissue with sparse hematopoietic cells
Overall hypocellular marrow; no tumor cell clusters appreciated at this magnification
Mosaic cement lines and osteoclast detail cannot be assessed at this low power
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows markedly increased bone mass composed of thickened, irregular, anastomosing trabeculae with scalloped contours. The intertrabecular spaces are largely replaced by loose fibrovascular connective tissue, and hematopoietic elements are sparse. No metastatic tumor is evident at this magnification, although higher power is needed to assess osteoclasts and cement lines. In conjunction with sclerotic lesions and elevated alkaline phosphatase, findings are consistent with Paget disease of bone.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows cohesive epithelial clusters within desmoplastic stroma that are keratin (and PSA/NKX3.1) positive, which are not seen here.
Hyperparathyroid bone shows dissecting (tunneling) resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis without the mosaic cement-line pattern, and has abnormal PTH/calcium.
Primary myelofibrosis has clustered atypical megakaryocytes and reticulin/collagen fibrosis within a hematopoietic marrow, rather than vascular connective tissue with hypocellularity.
